newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Promet to build houses in Zimbabwe.
newsitem.headline: Promet to build houses in Zimbabwe.

text.p: Malaysian maritime and engineering concern Promet Bhd said a wholly-owned subsidiary has entered into a joint venture agreement with a Zimbabwe firm to build residential houses with development value of Z$600 million (150 million ringgit).

In a statement, Promet said its Promet Zimbabwe Ltd signed the deal with ZimMal Holdings (Pte) Ltd to build 10,000 units of houses in the township of Cowdray Park, about 10-13 km from the centre of Bulawayo, Zimbabwe's second largest city.
Promet Zimbabwe will hold a 70 percent equity interest in the joint venture firm ZimMal Promet (Pte) Ltd, and ZimMal Holdings 30 percent.
